lib.state: Local state owned by the view.
lib.binding: A value shared with a parent view.
lib.observable: A model class observed by SwiftUI.
lib.environment: Reads a value from the environment.
lib.asyncFunc: An async function that can throw.
lib.logger: Structured logging, visible in the iPhone console.

trust.message:
Do you trust the authors of {name}?

To index and build a Swift package, SourceKit-LSP and the Swift tools run the code in its Package.swift with your rights. Trust it only if you wrote it or it comes from someone you trust.

In Restricted Mode you can still read and edit every file.
